title: Te Ngaru i Wehewehe i te Toto
intro: Whakaarohia he waipuke nui e piki ake ana i runga i te whenua, he Āka e mānu ana, ā, kotahi te wairua i mahue ki waho nā te whiriwhiri. I herea e te toto ki tētahi poropiti engari i wehea e te whakapono, i tūtaki tēnei tangata ki te karanga whakamutunga kia eke ki runga i te waka i te ngaru o te wai. Ka taea e koe te hura i te tuakiri kei muri i te whakakorenga?
clues: He uri ahau nō tētahi o ngā poropiti nui rawa atu a Allah, he whānau whakapono i whiriwhiria e au kia wehe atu.
I noho ahau i te wā o te Waipuke Nui, i te wā i taupokina ai te whenua e te whakaponokore pērā i te wai.
I te karangatanga mai a tōku pāpā ki ahau, i whakakahore ahau ki te eke tahi me te hunga whakapono ki roto i te Āaka.
I mea ahau ka rapu piringa ahau ki runga i te maunga hei tiaki i ahau i te wai.
I korerotia mai ki ahau kāore he mea hei tiaki i te ture a Allah i taua rā engari ko te aroha noa.
I taupokina ahau e ngā ngaru, ā, i toremi ahau, ā, i kīia mai ki tōku pāpā ehara ahau i tōna whānau tika.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Zayd ibn Harithah

Poropiti a Ihimaera, te tama a Poropiti a Ihāperaima
identity.answer: Te Tama Whakakore a te Poropiti a Noa

Te moe mō ngā rautau i roto i te ana hei mawhiti i te whakatoi
trial.answer: Te kore e eke ki te Āraka, me te rapu maunga hei piringa

location.answer: I rapu te maunga teitei hei piringa i te Waipuke

outcome.label: Hua
options: Horomia ana e te whenua ngā taonga mō te whakapehapeha
I whakawhiwhia he kingitanga me te mana ki runga i ngā hau me ngā jinn
I whakamatao, i haumaru hoki i te mea kua huri te ahi hei rangimārie
I whakaarahia oratia ki te rangi, i whakaorangia i te ripeka

outcome.answer: I toremi i te Waipuke, ā, i kīia ehara i te whānau tika

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
